I have been using Spotify for a while now, but only a couple months after I got it I realized that you could watch videos on it. I started loving a lot of the video podcasts. There are two things I will say about the video podcasts. 

1: I have seen some of the podcasts build small communities and it’s wonderful. These are usually podcasts that upload random compilations per a viewer’s request. These podcasts are especially good for people that don’t have YouTube. They have a lot of good content. But recently, Spotify has removing A LOT of those podcasts. I have seen so many people upset about it. Just today, one of my favorite video podcasts was taken down. Spotify usually does this because of copyright law, but almost every podcast that uploads stuff that isn’t theirs gives credit to the actual creator. 

2: Spotify will take down harmless video podcasts that have built a loving community, but they won’t take down podcasts that spread leaked content. Just a couple weeks ago, season two of a very popular show was leaked. A lot of it was. (Season two of the show is currently not out.) The person that leaked it was arrested and fined a large amount of money. Then someone made a podcast was some of the leaked songs/content. Spotify has done absolutely nothing yet about it. It’s extremely upsetting and disappointing.

I hope Spotify acknowledges this review and takes of this.
